steps.title: Establish Project Identity
steps.description: Configure the Smart Khata app metadata, package name 'com.smartkhata.app', and application identifier.

steps.title: Create Build Configuration
steps.description: Configure the app's build.gradle with proper compile and target SDK versions (34) matching JDK 17 environment constraints.

steps.title: Define App Theme & Colors
steps.description: Configure light-themed custom color resources (blue primary, greens, reds) and styles to support a premium look and feel.

steps.title: Design Card & Button Drawables
steps.description: Create rounded shape XML drawables for card backgrounds, buttons, pill badges, and input elements.

steps.title: Configure App Manifest
steps.description: Set up AndroidManifest.xml declaring correct package, launcher activities, standard Material Light theme, and launcher icon hooks.

steps.title: Set Up Database Schema
steps.description: Create SQLite database open helper to manage persistent tables for Customers and Transactions with cascading deletes on customer deletion.

steps.title: Create Modern App Main Layout
steps.description: Implement a full layout supporting Splash Loader screen, Bottom Navigation bar, Home/Dashboard section, Customers list, Transactions list, and Settings.

steps.title: Implement Dialog Layouts
steps.description: Build high-fidelity custom dialogue input fields for Adding Customer, Recording Udhaar/Jama, and editing shop credentials.

steps.title: Build Dynamic List Item Layouts
steps.description: Design visual templates for customer rows with beautiful circle letter avatars and transaction rows with clear transaction pill types.

steps.title: Develop Main Application Logic
steps.description: Implement MainActivity.java implementing view switches, database interactions, dynamic lists, sound synthetic alerts, and state management.

steps.title: Configure Demo Data Injector
steps.description: Write and hook a mock data populator inside DatabaseHelper to enrich the initial view with illustrative transactions for a beautiful demonstration.

steps.title: Integrate WhatsApp Intent Reminder
steps.description: Program the SMS fallback and external WhatsApp Intent dispatcher inside the customer profiles with custom pre-filled polite reminder messages.

steps.title: Building Smart Khata
steps.description: Invoke gradle command to compile source, validate layout assets, link SQLite, and produce the final APK.
